title: Is Your Streaming TV Spend Really Going to Streaming TV Inventory?
summary: DV’s Verified Streaming TV and DV Scibids AI offerings help ensure that streaming TV ads appear in quality inventory at the most efficient price.
body_markdown:
Advertisers pay a premium for streaming TV content and its viewing experience. But those dollars aren’t guaranteed to fund placements within the movies, series and live sports inventory advertisers expect.


Instead, through audience extensions, ads for which marketers pay streaming TV prices can end up in less-premium places, including gaming and music streaming apps or other non-TV media with lower dollar values. Even curated deals aren’t immune: In a 2025 analysis, DV found that around 15% of U.S. CTV impressions delivered through programmatic direct, programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals served outside the intended inventory.


1


Without visibility into those placements, advertisers may not know how much of their spend bypassed the inventory they intended to purchase. DV estimates that such misplaced spend accounts for about $4 billion a year.


2


## Serve in the Environment You Paid For


The question isn’t simply whether an impression reached the intended audience. Did it also serve within the viewing experience the advertiser paid for?


Verified Streaming TV


™


directs spend toward real streaming TV environments, then verifies where ads actually ran.


Verified Streaming TV helps advertisers get more from their TV investments by combining pre-bid segments that direct spend toward TV-like inventory with post-bid measurement that verifies where ads actually ran. Deals powered by DV Scibids AI™ build on that foundation, helping advertisers strengthen their buying power by accessing verified Streaming TV inventory at more efficient prices.


## Pre-Bid Segments Align With Quality Inventory


Pre-bid controls make inventory quality part of the buying decision before money is spent. A streaming TV impression can serve on a CTV, smartphone or computer; the challenge is identifying that inventory across devices and keeping bids focused on the professionally produced programming advertisers intended to buy.


DV’s Verified Streaming TV segments combine AI-powered classification with human oversight to identify websites and apps that offer full episodes, on-demand programming and live or scheduled television.


For run-of-network PMPs with obscured app identifiers, DV also offers a segment that includes inventory it has verified. This helps advertisers maintain access to qualifying supply while reducing misplaced spend on non-TV placements.


## AI Bidding Optimizes Costs


Now that your spend is going toward the right inventory, are you paying more than you need to? There are always opportunities to improve your buying strategy so it addresses not only where the budget goes but also how much qualifying inventory it can buy.


DV Scibids AI elevates advertising effectiveness by allowing brands to optimize to the KPIs that drive their desired outcomes. Based on client input, we create dynamic algorithms that optimize bidding to achieve those KPIs, balancing performance with cost. Advertisers can also pair the inventory controls provided by Verified Streaming TV with ongoing optimization against cost and reach, helping their budgets go further while preserving their inventory standards.


## Measure What Your Investment Delivered


After a campaign runs, advertisers need to know how much of their streaming TV investment reached the right inventory, and whether delivery matched their expectations.


Verified Streaming TV post-bid measurement provides that visibility, showing how many impressions ran on streaming TV inventory on CTV, mobile and web, wherever DV tags are accepted.


Those insights give advertisers evidence to guide their next buy. Teams can assess delivery across media partners, identify where pre-bid controls could help and bring more-informed questions to renewals and negotiations.


## Make Inventory Quality Part of the Workflow


Inventory quality should be an ongoing consideration throughout a streaming TV campaign. Defining what qualifies before bidding, optimizing what you pay and reviewing delivery afterward helps you make each buying decision with greater confidence.


Verified Streaming TV brings these checks into a broader workflow alongside content-level intelligence and suitability controls. What you learn from one campaign can inform the next, helping you keep streaming TV investments aligned with your expectations and make your budget go further.
